zephaniah.3.p1.b1.text: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

zephaniah.3.p1.b2.text: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.

zephaniah.3.p1.b3.text: Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.

zephaniah.3.p1.b4.text: Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.

zephaniah.3.p1.b5.text: The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn

zephaniah.3.p1.b6.text: yet the unjust know no shame.

zephaniah.3.p1.b7.text: I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through

zephaniah.3.p1.b8.text: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ … But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.

zephaniah.3.p1.b9.text: Therefore wait for Me … until the day I rise to testify

zephaniah.3.p1.b10.text: … For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.

zephaniah.3.p2.b1.text: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.

zephaniah.3.p2.b2.text: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.

zephaniah.3.p2.b3.text: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.

zephaniah.3.p2.b4.text: … But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble

zephaniah.3.p2.b5.text: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!

zephaniah.3.p2.b6.text: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”

zephaniah.3.p2.b7.text: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered

zephaniah.3.p2.b8.text: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you … says the LORD.
